review_method: Collector and field-contract review plus current primary official documentation; no MTC fingerprint observations or held-out values inspected by this semantic review.

provenance_policy.official_document: Direct source semantics only; not a project relation or risk verdict.
provenance_policy.official_derived_semantic_rule: Project inference using official semantics and explicit collector/context assumptions.
provenance_policy.device_mined_rule: Relation or tolerance learned or empirically selected using discovery/development observations; official citations do not remove data dependence.
provenance_policy.collector_implementation_invariant: Constraint caused by the collector's own assignments; not independent cross-surface evidence.

sources.title: User-Agent Reduction on Android WebView
sources.scope: Current page says default WebView UA reduction begins in Android 17; Chrome desktop/Android UA reduced since Chrome 107. Reduced OS/CPU/build token is not the actual device OS.
sources.limitations: Page publication date is 2024 but content has changed; custom UA remains possible. Do not use an old Android 16 threshold or require Browser and WebView UA equality.

sources.title: WebSettings user agent APIs
sources.scope: Settings user agent identifies the specific WebView configuration; applications may override it.
sources.limitations: Default UA, settings UA, runtime JS UA and external Browser UA are distinct observations. Equality needs instance and timing assumptions.

sources.title: WebView getCurrentWebViewPackage
sources.scope: Current provider package API exists from API 26; collector parses version prefix into provider_major.
sources.limitations: Package version convention is not a universal proof of renderer Chrome version; unavailable provider data is not a conflict.

sources.title: DisplayMetrics available display dimensions and density
sources.scope: widthPixels/heightPixels describe available display dimensions. The field named screen_resolution_physical is collected from resources.displayMetrics and must be interpreted as App reported display size. scaledDensity deprecated at API 34 because adaptive nonlinear font scaling invalidates simple scale assumptions.
sources.limitations: Do not call this field native physical panel resolution or equate it with Display.Mode, Browser viewport, xdpi/ydpi or devicePixelRatio.

sources.title: Display.Mode physical dimensions
sources.scope: Current mode width/height in pixels; methods added API 23. Application UI scaling can produce different App available dimensions.
sources.limitations: Current mode dimensions are not a guarantee of native panel resolution or CSS viewport dimensions.

sources.title: CSSOM View Module devicePixelRatio and screen geometry
sources.scope: CSS pixels, reported screen area and devicePixelRatio; DPR uses current page zoom with scale factor 1.0.
sources.limitations: Editor's draft as inspected 2026-09-22. Page zoom and visual viewport scale are distinct; reported screen, available screen, client and visual viewport sizes are not interchangeable. No universal Native panel equality follows.

sources.title: WEBGL_debug_renderer_info extension
sources.scope: Underlying graphics vendor/renderer strings may be privacy masked; this optional extension exposes unmasked strings.
sources.limitations: Probe only reads strings when extension exists. Unknown or masked strings cannot become GPU-family contradictions; ANGLE/driver wrappers need explicit normalization. native_gpu_renderer and egl_renderer are assigned the same local value.

sources.title: HTML canvas getContext context mode
sources.scope: Requesting a different context type on a canvas already bound to one returns null. Probe requests WebGL1 then WebGL2 on the same canvas.
sources.limitations: webgl2_supported=false can be a probe artifact when WebGL1 succeeds; exclude it from real capability inference. Do not retroactively alter observations or repair the collector within a rule experiment.

sources.title: Navigator hardwareConcurrency
sources.scope: Potentially available logical processors, with user-agent limits/privacy lowering allowed. Standard value is at least 1; probe fallback is 0.
sources.limitations: Cross-container equality and equality to actual CPU cores do not follow. Zero is ambiguous fallback; one remains valid.

sources.title: Device Memory API, Working Draft 2026-03-30
sources.scope: Approximate quantized memory in GiB, secure context, implementation-defined lower/upper bounds that may change over time and device type.
sources.limitations: Working draft, not universal implementation attestation. Do not hardcode 8 GiB as permanent maximum. Probe zero fallback is not real RAM; Native totalMem/1024^3 is not directly equal to Web memory.

sources.title: SensorManager getSensorList and getDefaultSensor
sources.scope: Default sensor requires existence and permissions; list includes wake-up and non-wake-up sensors. Counts and distinct type/name/vendor lists are generated from one collector list.
sources.limitations: Do not require has_sensor iff type membership; only positive implication is a conservative project candidate. Count bounds are collector self-consistency, not new independent device relations.

sources.title: TimeZone getRawOffset
sources.scope: Native offset is standard-time raw offset excluding daylight saving, converted from milliseconds to minutes.
sources.limitations: Not directly the negative of current JavaScript timezoneOffset when DST applies; identical zone IDs are not required for aliases.

sources.title: ECMAScript Date.prototype.getTimezoneOffset
sources.scope: Current Date timezone offset in minutes, with UTC-minus-local convention.
sources.limitations: Compare timestamps/settings when relating observations; Native rawOffset excludes DST and has opposite sign.

sources.title: Web Audio API privacy considerations
sources.scope: Rendering differences arise from DSP architecture, resampling, rounding, compiler and CPU implementation. Probe task sample rate derives from real-time context or 44100 fallback.
sources.limitations: Cross-container audio hash equality is not a universal invariant. Probe audio_output_latency mixes outputLatency and baseLatency; no direct hardware latency equality.

sources.title: HTML NavigatorPlugins PDF compatibility surface
sources.scope: Modern plugin/mime arrays are a PDF compatibility surface, including standard lists when supported and empty lists otherwise.
sources.limitations: Not an installed-plugin inventory or independent device identity. Older engines and per-browser PDF settings differ; zero may be valid or fallback.

sources.title: ActivityManager.MemoryInfo
sources.scope: Collector reads availMem and totalMem from the same MemoryInfo and divides both by 1024^3; nonnegative available-memory versus total-memory bound is a semantic/collector consistency candidate.
sources.limitations: MemoryInfo is runtime usable-memory information, not retail memory capacity. This does not justify exact alignment with browser deviceMemory or an attack conclusion.
